title: Blush ivory: warmer castle stone, blush marble, stronger pink roofs
chosen_from: material_variants.py round mat1, variant v2_blush_ivory, judged on HeroCam_V2_MarbleReference, the palace forecourt, East_QuarterStreet58 and a corridor aerial on 2026-09-13
why: The reference's castle city is warm ivory and pastel pink; the recovered stone was a neutral grey-white (linear 0.58/0.57/0.56). A warmer plaza stone was tried too (v3) and rejected: the paving went yellow-brown.
